frozen_body: The proposed right-handed representation gives up the conventional holomorphic SL(2,C)_L x SL(2,C)_R representation used for group-coordinate analytic continuation, while retaining a complex spacetime with real Minkowski and Euclidean subspaces.
exact_tradeoff: conventional formulation: independent left/right complex group roles act on M2(C)
right-handed formulation: only right-handed group role acts on M2(C)
right-handed action uses adjoint/conjugation and is not the same holomorphic two-factor group-coordinate action
both formulations retain the same complex carrier and the frozen Minkowski/Euclidean real slices
semantic_guards: This is a source-authored formulation tradeoff, not a DTS successor judgment.
Absence of the left spacetime action is inherited only from the exact right-handed source formulation already closed in W-SSC-131.
No Lisi or cross-track semantics are used.
